Under the terms of the transaction, LINE GAMES will acquire 0.03 million shares at KRW 72,917 per share. from Hooseok Jung, Howon Im, Junyoung Jeon, and Woochul Kwon will transfer 14.4%, 6.84%, 6.84%, and 0.72% stake respectively.
